reader.requirement: At --std 85 a detail report group is processed only as the result of a GENERATE naming it (or GENERATE report-name), every other report group type is processed automatically by the report writer, no statement can name a non-detail group in GENERATE, and with no GENERATE nothing is processed.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel < 2002 refuses GENERATE report-name for a report with more than one detail (§1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR6)
DialectBehavior.GroupIndicateConsumedByIssuedGenerate (GROUP INDICATE bookkeeping after the detail), not which groups are processed

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel/IsActive in ReportWriterBinder.cs and ReportWriter.cs
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: which groups GENERATE processes and which are automatic is the same code; the edition arms touch only the SR6 refusal and GROUP INDICATE
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f29_04 covers the automatic RH/CH/CF/RF processing and detail processing per GENERATE; the GENERATE-of-a-non-detail refusal and the no-GENERATE report are not exercised there

probes.printed: error COBOL0899: GENERATE CFG: the named report group is not a DETAIL group
error COBOL6823: ... must include no more than one detail report group (ISO §1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR6)

probes.expected: INITIATE then TERMINATE with no GENERATE processes no group

probes.printed: PH, CH, CF, CFF, PF and RF all printed with no statement naming them; one DE line per GENERATE DTL (report identical at --std 2023)
probes.expected: non-detail groups automatic, details per GENERATE

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR1  (3.20.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1

reader.notes: GenerateCore presents RH/PH/CH on the first GENERATE and CF/CH on a break, AdvancePage presents PF/PH, TerminateCore presents CF/PF/RF only if a GENERATE ran, and only the named or sole detail is presented. BindGenerate refuses a non-detail operand.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR1-GR8 and XIII.4.3.3 SR1-SR2. Refusal probes at --std 85, compile-only (r5gSUB-002, r5gPH-002, r5gRH-002, r5gRF-002, r5gPF-002, r5gWS-002, r5gSC-002): GENERATE of a subordinate LINE entry of a detail, of a working-storage item and of a sum counter refused COBOL1757; GENERATE of PH, RH, RF and PF groups refused COBOL0899 (the reader tried only CF). The first runs (-001) were refused for PAGE LIMIT 20 with no HEADING/FIRST DETAIL (COBOL2199), a probe fault fixed in -002. Positive r5gok-001 (GENERATE DA, GENERATE RPT, GENERATE DA OF RPT): RH, PH, DA, DA, CF 003, PF at line 19, RF, i.e. every non-detail group processed with no statement naming it, the detail presented only for the two GENERATE data-name, and the summary GENERATE still subtotalled. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR1  (3.20.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.4.3.3 SR1  (4.3.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1'.
